Alternatively, send the form only by registered Indian Post to: Office of the Superintendent of Police, Jagdalpur, District Bastar, PIN 494001. Postal applications must reach the office by 12.12.2026 within office hours.
If applying by post, keep the registered post receipt and bring it on the date fixed for recruitment (compulsory).
